hotels.title: New Zealand Nature Treehut Escape in Pauanui with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Drink & NZ$50 Dining Credit
hotels.description: Nestled in native bushland on the Coromandel Peninsula, this serene retreat is just a two-hour drive from Auckland. Treehut-style studios sit among the treetops with balconies looking out over coastal greenery, while the heated pool, spa pool and sauna offer true relaxation after days exploring the coast. Complimentary bike hire, tennis courts and a gym keep active travellers busy, with Miha restaurant and bar providing onsite drinks and dining. The Coromandel delivers plenty beyond the resort. Pauanui Beach is a 20-minute walk for swimming and coastal strolls, while the nearby Mount Paku offers hiking trails and panoramic views. Whether you're here for beach days or bush walks, this nature oasis puts you right in the heart of one of New Zealand’s most scenic coastal regions.
